messages.model-info.disclosure-description: Results are generic estimates, not measurements of an individual.
messages.model-info.limitations.assessment-copy: the guided sequence remains a separate right upper-limb workflow. Explorer region choices do not change its protocol. It cannot identify a painful tissue, rule out urgent conditions or replace a qualified clinician.
messages.model-info.limitations.interpretation-co: activation and active tensile-force contribution are model outputs—not measured effort, personal force, tissue load, pain, damage or diagnostic evidence. Joint reaction forces are not calculated.
messages.model-info.limitations.quality-copy: colors appear only when paths and values are valid and the posture passes the static balance and reserve-torque limits. A failed result remains gray.
messages.model-info.limitations.static-copy: there is no held object, contact force, measured support, speed, acceleration, fatigue or person-specific co-contraction. Dynamic movement can require different activation.
messages.model-info.limitations.technical-copy: This distribution includes documented source-model modifications; see the source-change record below.
messages.model-info.shows.activation-copy: colors show a static, gravity-only model estimate. The calculation includes passive model forces and assumes the rest of the body is externally supported.
messages.model-info.shows.hand-copy: finger posture and intrinsic-hand muscles come from the articulated right-hand variant. Hand presets are unloaded shapes without object contact; they do not estimate grip or pinch force. Mirror display does not change the calculated side.
messages.model-info.shows.model-intro: , using its primary full-body model and detailed manipulation hand variant. The complete skeleton is shown as quiet context while
